youtube.title: Why Do We Hiccup? 😮 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
A hiccup is an involuntary contraction of the diaphragm, followed almost immediately by the closing of the vocal cords (glottis), which makes the 'hic' sound. Common triggers include eating quickly, carbonated drinks, swallowing air and sudden temperature changes. Most bouts stop on their own.
